title: A PRAYER FOR
YOUR DAILY WORK
end: The Morning Altar — begin every sunrise in prayer
stock_queries: soft morning sunlight hitting wooden table
mist rising over a calm mountain lake at dawn
golden sun rays through open window curtains
dew drops on green leaves at sunrise
early morning sky with soft clouds
golden light illuminating a quiet home interior

scenes.a: That task you are dreading feels too heavy to start without a clear sense of purpose.
And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.
Lord, help me to carry this focus into the hours that lie ahead of me today.
Let every conversation, every choice, and every small labor be an offering of true worship.
Quiet my anxious heart so I may see Your presence in the ordinary parts of life.
May my actions reflect Your grace as I move through this world with You today, Amen.
